en: Sepia-toned postcard featuring a coastal rocky scene viewed through a natural rock arch or cave opening. On the left, small white buildings and what appears to be a lighthouse stand near the cliff edge, with the sea visible behind them. A palm tree and rugged shoreline are in the middle ground. The image occupies the upper left portion, while the rest of the card is densely covered with handwritten text in Greek. There is also a printed caption near the bottom left and a date written by hand (19-7-1900).
